name: The My Bookmarks page's bulk delete with a clip file in use, as admin on Long Test Movie, on the My Bookmarks page filtered to it, while bookmarks-page-probe.mjs holds the clip file of its 'page-probe inuse held' bookmark open the way a download holds it: that bookmark and a point of the same video seeded here are ticked and deleted with the clips (the box ticked by hand: it is unticked by default since My Clips lists kept clips); the server deletes the point and answers InUse for the held one after its three attempts, and the dialog stays with '1 bookmark deleted. One could not be deleted: a clip file is in use (being played or downloaded). Try again shortly.', the held bookmark still ticked in the group drawn again (the same video: it used to lose its tick with the group), the bar up, the server still holding it with its clip file. Then Cancel. Seeds and deletes its own point; the probe releases the file and deletes the held bookmark afterwards.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the probe's held bookmark (a Fast clip, its file held open by the probe) on the movie, and a point of the same video seeded here
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe inuse held', itemId: __vars.movieId, limit: 5 })); const held = r.Items.find(b => b.Name === 'page-probe inuse held' && b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Completed' && b.Clip.FileName); if (!held) throw new Error('no held bookmark with a completed clip: the probe seeds it first'); const T = 10000000; const point = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 80 * T, Name: 'page-probe inuse point' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return { held: held.Id, point: point.Id, file: held.Clip.FileName };

steps.name: the page filtered to the movie
both rows there, the held one with its clip ready
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy')) return false; const row = (id) => c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'); return !!row(__vars.seed.held) && !!row(__vars.seed.point) && !!row(__vars.seed.held).querySelector('.jfbm-clip-ready'); })()

steps.name: tick both
steps.script: const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); for (const id of [__vars.seed.held, __vars.seed.point]) r.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"] .jfbm-row-select-box').click(); return r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-count').textContent;

steps.name: 'Delete 2 bookmarks?' with 'Also delete their clips (1 clip file)', unticked (since My Clips)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Delete 2 bookmarks?') return false; const box = p.querySelector('.jfbm-delete-clip input'); return !!box && !box.checked && box.nextElementSibling.textContent === 'Also delete their clips (1 clip file)'; })()

steps.name: the point deleted, the held one kept as InUse: the dialog stays with the sentence and the held one alone to delete; its row ticked in the group drawn again, the bar '1 bookmark selected'; the server still has it with its clip file
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const error = p && p.querySelector('.jfbm-error'); if (!p || !error || !error.textContent) return false; const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); const row = (id) => c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'); if (c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || row(__vars.seed.point) || !row(__vars.seed.held)) return false; const status = async (q, query) => (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(q, query), { headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } })).status; return { error: error.textContent, description: p.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-description').textContent, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - __vars.t0), checked: row(__vars.seed.held).querySelector('.jfbm-row-select-box').checked, count: r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-count').textContent, bar: r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-bar').classList.contains('hide'), held: await status('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.held), heldFile: await status('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.held + '/Clip/File', { download: 'false' }), point: await status('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.point), deleteDisabled: [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-actions button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Delete').disabled }; })()

steps.name: as expected (the three attempts 200 ms apart: at least 0.38 s)
steps.assert: __vars.inUse.error === '1 bookmark deleted. One could not be deleted: a clip file is in use (being played or downloaded). Try again shortly.' && __vars.inUse.description === '"page-probe inuse held" will be deleted.' && __vars.inUse.ms >= 380 && __vars.inUse.checked && __vars.inUse.count === '1 bookmark selected' && !__vars.inUse.bar && __vars.inUse.held === 200 && __vars.inUse.heldFile === 200 && __vars.inUse.point === 404 && !__vars.inUse.deleteDisabled

steps.name: closed, the held one still ticked
the held bookmark is left to the probe (its file is still held); nothing else of this check remains
